challenges.title: Color-changing Button
challenges.desc: Create a button that changes the background color when clicked.
challenges.task: Write a function toggleColor(current) that returns "green" if current is "white", and "white" otherwise.
hints: Think of this as a simple if/else based on the input value.

challenges.title: Reverse a String
challenges.desc: Write a function that reverses any given string.
challenges.task: Write a function reverseString(str) that returns the string reversed.
hints: Arrays have a .reverse() method — strings don't, but you can convert first.

challenges.title: FizzBuzz
challenges.desc: Classic FizzBuzz: return Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5, FizzBuzz for both.
challenges.task: Write a function fizzbuzz(n) that returns "Fizz" if n is divisible by 3, "Buzz" if divisible by 5, "FizzBuzz" if divisible by both, otherwise the number as a string.
hints: Check divisibility by 15 first, or check both 3 and 5 together before checking either alone.
Remember to return a string in the final else case, using String(n) or `${n}`.

challenges.title: Palindrome Checker
challenges.desc: Determine whether a given string reads the same forwards and backwards.
challenges.task: Write a function isPalindrome(str) that returns true if str reads the same forwards and backwards, false otherwise. Ignore case.
hints: Lowercase the string first so 'Racecar' and 'racecar' compare equal.
Compare the string to its own reversed version.

challenges.title: Array Deduplication
challenges.desc: Remove duplicate values from an array without using a library.
challenges.task: Write a function dedupe(arr) that returns a new array with duplicate values removed, preserving order.
hints: A Set automatically discards duplicate values.
new Set(arr) followed by spreading it back into an array works well here.

challenges.title: Sum of Digits
challenges.desc: Add together every digit in a positive integer.
challenges.task: Write a function sumDigits(n) that returns the sum of all digits in the positive integer n.
hints: Convert the number to a string so you can look at each digit individually.
String(n).split('').reduce((sum, d) => sum + Number(d), 0) sums the digits.

challenges.title: Memoization Cache
challenges.desc: Implement a memoize() helper that caches results of an expensive function.
challenges.task: Write a function memoize(fn) that returns a new function caching results by their stringified arguments, so repeated calls with the same input reuse the cached result.

tests.desc: memoize(square)(4) → 16 on first and second call

hints: Use an object or Map keyed by JSON.stringify(args) to store previous results.
If the key already exists in the cache, return the cached value instead of calling fn again.

challenges.title: Debounce Helper
challenges.desc: Build a debounce(fn, delay) helper used constantly in real-world UI code.
challenges.task: Write a function debounce(fn, delay) that returns a new function which only calls fn after 'delay' ms have passed without another call.
hints: Use setTimeout and clearTimeout to reset the timer on every call.
Store the timer id in a variable captured by the closure.
